tools.name: catalog_query
tools.description: Query the workspace catalog by search, get, list, audit, or status.

cursor.description: opaque cursor returned by an earlier list or search

id.description: catalog item ID; required for get

mode.description: catalog operation: search, get, list, audit, or status; omit when using cursor

query.description: lexical search text; required for search

tools.name: check_report_import
tools.description: Import a local check report; may require approval.

byte_limit.description: maximum report bytes; default and maximum 1048576

checklist_path.description: workspace-relative verification-check.v1 YAML or JSON path

response_view.description: full or receipt; default full; receipt omits the imported payload

tools.name: checkpoint_write
tools.description: Write a checkpoint; may require approval.

tools.name: data_query
tools.description: Read ranges or query JSON, JSONL, logs, CSV, and TSV; requests session read approval for an external source.

cursor.description: opaque cursor returned by an earlier data_query

dialect.description: jsonl-simple, json-pointer, csv, tsv, exact, or regex

encoding.description: utf-8, cp949, or euc-kr; defaults to utf-8

fields.description: top-level fields to project; empty returns all fields

value.description: value text; integers remain decimal strings

mode.description: text_range, jsonl, json, delimited, or log; omit with cursor

pattern.description: exact text or RE2 pattern for log mode

pointer.description: RFC 6901 pointer for json mode; default root

ref.description: source ref returned by another RepoPlane tool

tools.name: memo_write
tools.description: Write a memo or typed host fact; may require approval.

tools.name: memory_backup
tools.description: Export portable durable memory and retained Runner evidence without secrets or restart; requests approval for the destination directory.

destination.description: existing absolute directory outside the workspace and state directory

tools.name: path_explain
tools.description: Explain workspace, Git, link, encoding, newline, rule, and basename facts; requests session read approval for an external path.

action.description: intended action such as read or edit

encoding.description: explicit codec to test: utf-8, cp949, or euc-kr

tools.name: project_records
tools.description: Query durable verification, checkpoint, memo, environment, run, and artifact records.

cursor.description: opaque cursor from an earlier project_records query

id.description: opaque record ID; required for get

kind.description: record kind filter: verification, checkpoint, memo, environment, run, or artifact

mode.description: record operation: search, list, or get; omit when using cursor

payload_fields.description: exact top-level payload fields to return; empty returns the full payload

source.description: source filter: observed, imported, user_asserted, or llm_proposed

updated_after.description: RFC3339 lower bound for record update time

validity.description: validity filter: current, stale, unknown, or superseded

tools.name: run_execute
tools.description: Execute or reuse one plan after dependency revalidation; requests session execution approval when needed.

tools.name: run_inspect
tools.description: Inspect/cancel a run or page retained streams and artifacts; requests session execution approval when needed.

action.description: status, stdout, stderr, artifact, or cancel; default status

artifact_ref.description: artifact record ref required by the artifact action

tools.name: run_prepare
tools.description: Validate a capability and create a durable environment-bound plan; requests session execution approval when needed.

arguments.description: typed values declared by the capability argument schema

cache_mode.description: cache lookup mode: auto or bypass; default: auto

configuration.description: bounded execution configuration name; default: default

tools.name: runtime_access
tools.description: Inspect, grant with explicit user approval, or revoke ephemeral stdio access without configuration edits or restart.

grant_id.description: grant ID returned by status or grant

kind.description: read_path, intent_write, report_import, runner_execute, cache_reuse, or memory_export

path.description: workspace-relative read path or absolute memory export destination

tools.name: runtime_config
tools.description: Inspect or change live sources, workspace, state, or HTTP without restarting stdio.

tools.name: workspace_search
tools.description: Search names, text, Git history, or configured symbols with bounded evidence; requests session read approval for an external root.

cursor.description: opaque cursor from an earlier workspace_search

encoding.description: text encoding: utf-8, cp949, or euc-kr

generated.description: generated path policy: exclude or include

ignored.description: ignored path policy: exclude or include

match_kind.description: Git channel: all, commit, path, or diff

mode.description: filename, exact, regex, git_history, or symbol; omit with cursor

pattern_syntax.description: Git pattern: exact or regex; default exact

vendor.description: vendor path policy: exclude or include
